📺 Chicago Fire (2012–Present)

Chicago Fire follows the brave firefighters, rescue squad members, and paramedics of Firehouse 51 as they risk their lives protecting the people of Chicago. From dangerous building fires and devastating accidents to life-threatening rescues, the team faces intense emergencies that test their courage, teamwork, and determination. Led by dedicated professionals like Kelly Severide and Matthew Casey, the firefighters also navigate complicated relationships, personal struggles, and heartbreaking losses outside the firehouse. Through unforgettable rescues, emotional moments, and powerful friendships, Chicago Fire explores bravery, sacrifice, loyalty, and the extraordinary dedication of first responders who put their lives on the line to save others.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Emergency Services

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Michael Brandt & Derek Haas

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock in the United States. Availability varies by region.
